Follow-up to v0.1.77, from the next three joins on it.

## Server

### Fixed
- When the record swap answers the client's blank-key load, the corrected load is no longer re-issued. The game performs a follow-up lookup by the same blank key about 30 ms after the load, and that lookup is what binds the client's inventory id. The re-issued load had to undo the swap first, so the follow-up found the blank record and the client came up bound to that record's inventory: garbled hotbar, starting items, or an empty inventory, while the server pawn held the saved items on every load. The swap now stays in place through the follow-up and is undone at the first player-record save or after two seconds, whichever comes first. The re-issued load remains the path when the swap cannot be made.
